observations: Photo 0 shows two exhaust manifolds with catalytic converters attached, lying on a dirt ground.
Both units have a metallic, rusted appearance with visible signs of heat discoloration and surface corrosion.
The left unit has a flange with multiple bolt holes and a wire harness attached to the converter.
The right unit has a similar structure but with a different flange design, featuring three circular openings.
No visible branding, model numbers, or part numbers are readable on either unit.
The seller's text claims these are 'first grade catalysts for merchandise benz 500 166 engine'.
